pkgmetadata.longdescription: QindaQt Office is the office suite for the QindaQt desktop: QindaWrite (word processor), QindaCalc (spreadsheet), QindaShow (presentations), QindaNote (notes with pen input), QindaMail (mail and calendar: IMAP, POP3, SMTP, CalDAV, iCalendar, Exchange and Microsoft 365), QindaBooks (bookkeeping, with Mercury and Stripe connections), QindaBase (databases), QindaDiagram (diagrams) and QindaPlan (project plans), behind a shared ribbon. Every document lives in an ordinary top-level window so the desktop's window containers provide tab and split grouping, and each window exports its menu to the panel over the desktop's D-Bus dbusmenu stack. AI assistance runs through the user's Claude/Codex/Kimi CLI subscriptions or OpenAI-/Anthropic-compatible HTTP endpoints.
